root_cause_label: Environment/API Discovery Loop Never Transitions to Implementation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent became stuck in an endless environment-setup and API-discovery loop after misclassifying an import error as a blocking problem, spending all 52 steps on exploration without ever writing a single line of the required add_channels() function.
t_err_evidence: Step 11: Agent gets ModuleNotFoundError when importing jaxley in the IPython/venv environment, but jaxley was already installed in the system Python (/usr/local/lib/python3.11). Instead of ignoring this and directly writing the implementation, the agent treats it as a blocker requiring full environment investigation, triggering a multi-step environment discovery loop.
t_commit_evidence: Step 25: After successfully resolving the environment issue by installing jaxley in the venv (step 23), the agent successfully imports jaxley and discovers available channel classes. At this point, all information needed for implementation is available, but the agent continues with 27 more steps of API exploration without ever writing to jaxley_conversion.py, making failure inevitable.
t_surface_evidence: Step 52: The runtime crashes with no implementation having been written. The task ends with jaxley_conversion.py still containing only the empty RGC class stub, providing an observable failure signal.
trigger_explanation: At step 11, the agent acted on the false premise that the ModuleNotFoundError in the IPython/venv environment was a critical blocker preventing implementation, when in fact jaxley was already installed system-wide. The agent could have simply written the implementation code without relying on the IPython shell for API exploration. This false premise triggered a protracted environment-discovery spiral instead of proceeding to the actual implementation task.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 12-23: Repeated failed attempts to install jaxley (exit_code -1 at step 12, then pip without pip error at step 17, sys.path hack causing ABI mismatch at step 22) all prior to t_commit. Additionally, steps 29-33 show repeated TypeErrors when trying to use the Jaxley API, suggesting the API exploration strategy itself was producing errors.
